I told Hollis in a thread on his #central-team message that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that number in #central-team on Oct 14, and nothing newer about it has come up in the channel since.

Hollis is a member of #central-team, and a seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so it was fine to share. I couldn't check the number against an account record because there are no Marrow files I can see, so I pointed Hollis to Tobias's message as the source.
